declarations.description:
A round, hoverable button that wraps a slotted icon. Renders a real `<button>` (focus is delegated to
it) so it is keyboard operable; set `aria-label` on the host to name it.
declarations.name: IconButton

cssProperties.description: Pressed state of a toggle button (see `selected`).
cssProperties.name: --c2-icon-button__selected--background-color

slots.description: The icon (an inline `<svg>`, a `c2-feather-*` or a `c2-mat-icon` element).

members.name: tooltip
members.description: Tooltip text shown after a short delay; also used as the accessible name when `aria-label` is not set.

members.name: disabled
members.description: Disables the button: no pointer events, no focus, reduced opacity.

members.name: ariaLabel
members.description: Accessible name forwarded to the inner `<button>`.

members.name: selected
members.description: Pressed state of a toggle button (`aria-pressed="true"`); styled with the `__selected--*` variables.

members.name: toggle
members.description: Declares a toggle button: `aria-pressed` is announced as `false` while not selected. Set by `c2-button-group` in selection modes.
